head: Shredder Weather forecasts snow at every ski area up to 15 days out
dek: Shredder Weather is a snow forecast app for skiers and snowboarders, with a multi-model snowfall forecast for every ski area worldwide. It was #40 among free Weather apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: It puts the high-end snowfall total front and center. It's free with in-app purchases, by Shredder Inc., and needs iOS 18.
where: iPhone, App Store, free with in-app purchases
means: Skiers can plan trips around the snow forecast at their resort.
todo: Find Shredder Weather in the App Store.
